spiritgiven.comments: Thank you for taking our feedback and implementing it! Also loved the positive attitude!

- we would first like to acknowledge our own poor spirit in that game, especially from our sideline
- we think that you came into calls with a fair minded approach and often looked at things objectively
- we think that the contact started off egregious, and while it improved after the spirit timeout we felt that there were still close calls and players initiating contact, stepping on our players and contact on the mark. We had two players injured in this game and felt this could’ve been avoided.
Certain players straddle their defender and make it so that no matter how we move in offense we cause contact. This got a bit better in the second half but was still happening
Coach on the sideline was saying some derogatory things about our team. Thank you to the players for being well spirited and respectful

We had spoken about it before the game and there were still two dangerous plays in the game as well as a few close calls. 
Just as a note cuz of broadcast: One of the cheers at the beginning of the game had loud swearing in it.

spiritreceived.comments: Please adjust to feedback on fast counts. Very enjoyable game. Thank you
There was great communication both within their team and with our team throughout the game. We appreciate the patient and early feedback from their spirit captains :)

2 x instances of Canada player bidding into Aus player in the air when they had vision of Aus player.
Canada Players on sideline during dangerous play thought it was not dangerous play and didn't speak up. Instance when Aus player called it in and a Canada player was aggressive and angry and called it out, this was after a different Canada player called it in. Aggressive communication in 2 other instances. After dangerous play bid 3 Canada players told Aus player off/rude on sideline. Good Comms
We appreciated that calls were resolved quickly and that body contact was improved by both teams throughout the game.
We had great communication both during and in between points, and we appreciated the effort from both teams to hold each other accountable to the rules.
